title: Design (after foundations): capability- and capacity-aware work routing across a host cluster
outcome: Design (after foundations): capability- and capacity-aware work routing across a host cluster
acceptance: Started only after the foundations land: TermAl cross-host mailboxes, Engram decentralized Git task sync, and host onboarding

A design brief describes how work is organised and routed across hosts by declared capabilities and capacity while Engram stays decentralized and Git-merged, with no change to claims, runtime authority or authority gates
Both projects' architects concur and Greg accepts before any implementation is filed
